@if(equals(outputs('Frequency'), 'Daily'), addHours(startOfDay(outputs('Due_from')), outputs('Hour')), if(equals(outputs('Frequency'), 'Weekly'), addHours(addDays(startOfDay(outputs('Due_from')), mod(add(sub(mod(add(outputs('Weekday'), 1), 7), dayOfWeek(outputs('Due_from'))), 7), 7)), outputs('Hour')), addHours(startOfMonth(outputs('Due_from')), outputs('Hour'))))

@if(greater(ticks(outputs('Next_due_base')), ticks(outputs('Due_from'))), outputs('Next_due_base'), if(equals(outputs('Frequency'), 'Daily'), addDays(outputs('Next_due_base'), 1), if(equals(outputs('Frequency'), 'Weekly'), addDays(outputs('Next_due_base'), 7), addHours(startOfMonth(addDays(startOfMonth(outputs('Due_from')), 32)), outputs('Hour')))))

parameters.select: ((ait_products eq '@{replace(item()?['ait_name'], '''', '''''')}' or startswith(ait_products, '@{replace(item()?['ait_name'], '''', '''''')}|') or endswith(ait_products, '|@{replace(item()?['ait_name'], '''', '''''')}') or contains(ait_products, '|@{replace(item()?['ait_name'], '''', '''''')}|')) and ait_modifiedon_src ge @{formatDateTime(addDays(first(item()?['ait_product_subscription'])?['createdon'], outputs('Backfill')), 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')})

parameters.select: ((ait_products eq '@{replace(item()?['ait_name'], '''', '''''')}' or startswith(ait_products, '@{replace(item()?['ait_name'], '''', '''''')}|') or endswith(ait_products, '|@{replace(item()?['ait_name'], '''', '''''')}') or contains(ait_products, '|@{replace(item()?['ait_name'], '''', '''''')}|')) and ait_modifiedon_src ge @{outputs('Pack_since')})

parameters.$filter: (@{join(body('All_clauses'), ' or ')}) and (ait_gamonth le @{outputs('Lookahead_end')} or (ait_gamonth eq null and (ait_previewmonth le @{outputs('Lookahead_end')} or ait_previewmonth eq null))) and not ait_roadmapitem_notification/any(n: n/_ait_subscriberid_value eq @{outputs('Sub_id')})

select.title: @item()?['title']
select.meta: @{item()?['products']}@{if(empty(item()?['status']), '', concat(' · ', item()?['status']))} · @{if(not(empty(item()?['ga'])), concat('GA ', substring(concat(item()?['ga'], '0000000'), 0, 7)), if(not(empty(item()?['preview'])), concat('Preview ', substring(concat(item()?['preview'], '0000000'), 0, 7)), if(not(empty(item()?['retirementMonth'])), concat('Retires ', substring(concat(item()?['retirementMonth'], '0000000'), 0, 7)), 'No date announced')))}
select.when: @if(not(empty(item()?['ga'])), concat('GA ', substring(concat(item()?['ga'], '0000000'), 0, 7)), if(not(empty(item()?['preview'])), concat('Preview ', substring(concat(item()?['preview'], '0000000'), 0, 7)), if(not(empty(item()?['retirementMonth'])), concat('Retires ', substring(concat(item()?['retirementMonth'], '0000000'), 0, 7)), 'No date announced')))
select.reason: @trim(concat(if(item()?['security'], 'Security issue. ', ''), if(item()?['action'], 'Action required. ', ''), if(item()?['retirement'], if(empty(item()?['retirementMonth']), 'Retirement, month not announced. ', concat('Retirement in ', substring(concat(item()?['retirementMonth'], '0000000'), 0, 7), if(item()?['inWindow'], ', inside your ', ', after your '), outputs('Critical_window'), '-month window. ')), '')))
select.sortKey: @concat(if(or(item()?['security'], item()?['action'], and(item()?['retirement'], item()?['inWindow'])), '1', if(item()?['retirement'], '2', '3')), '|', if(empty(item()?['ga']), if(empty(item()?['preview']), if(empty(item()?['retirementMonth']), '9999-12-31', item()?['retirementMonth']), item()?['preview']), item()?['ga']), '|', toLower(item()?['title']), '|', item()?['roadmapId'])

inputs.body: @union(outputs('Card_header'), if(empty(body('Critical_cards')), json('[]'), createArray(outputs('Critical_section'))), if(empty(body('Deprecation_cards')), json('[]'), createArray(outputs('Deprecation_section'))), if(empty(body('New_feature_cards')), json('[]'), createArray(outputs('New_feature_section'))))

assignments.value: {"status": "failed", "itemCount": 0, "message": "@{if(equals(actions('Post_card')?['status'], 'Skipped'), 'Writing the notification rows failed.', concat('Posting the card failed: ', take(string(coalesce(outputs('Post_card')?['body'], actions('Post_card')?['error'], 'no error text')), 500)))} The items stay queued for the next digest."}

{"status": "nosubs", "itemCount": 0, "message": "You don't follow any products yet. Type /packs or /products to find some, then /add <names>."}

{"status": "failed", "itemCount": 0, "message": "@{if(empty(outputs('Previous_result')?['message']), take(if(empty(body('Error_text')), 'The digest could not be built.', join(body('Error_text'), ' | ')), 2000), outputs('Previous_result')?['message'])}"}

inputs.message: @{if(equals(outputs('Digest_done')?['status'], 'failed'), 'Sorry, I could not send your digest right now. Please try again later.', outputs('Digest_done')?['message'])}
